reason: F3 gave fructose-rich information, but the planned N pulse was underdosed to 30% of target. The glucose-rich mirror is still needed to separate G/F uptake, yields and inhibition directions.
required_controls: Hit initial G/F ratio and execute +50 mg/L N pulse accurately; record actual t0 and actual pulse time/dose.
risk_if_skipped: qEF/iG/gammaF directions remain supported mainly by one asymmetric run; G-rich behavior remains weak.

recommendation: Run in Lot 2 as planned, but verify/correct initial YAN.
reason: F1 was high-N but actual YAN was 312 mg/L vs 410 mg/L target and was isothermal 18 C. This run is the main high-N warm/high-CO2 strip condition for aroma and CO2 loss.
required_controls: Pre-check/initial YAN; if actual YAN is below the target band, correct immediately and log the dose. Preserve condensate and online CO2.
risk_if_skipped: Temperature-aroma-loss directions rely too much on F3 high-temperature sugar run, not on a nitrogen-saturated strip run.

recommendation: Run in Lot 2 if biomass dosing can be standardized.
reason: Lot 1 measured initial viable X was far below nominal in F1/F3 and about 55% of nominal in F2. A deliberate biomass excitation remains valuable for X proportionality and yield separation.
required_controls: Measure inoculum/stock cell concentration before dosing; define actual X from Oculyze at t0; record any biomass addition volume/concentration.
risk_if_skipped: mu0/qN/yield directions stay confounded with uncontrolled inoculum variation.

recommendation: Keep only if a synthetic validation/reference run is needed; otherwise replace in Lot 3.
reason: After F1/F3 and planned F4/F5, another synthetic high-sugar reference is less critical than death/Kd0 or natural matrix transfer.
required_controls: If kept, execute as clean validation with accurate initial composition.
risk_if_skipped: Less independent synthetic validation, but limited loss of new DOE information.

recommendation: Run in Lot 3 unless natural-must modeling is deprioritized.
reason: Lot 1 is fully synthetic. At least one natural-must perturbation is required to test transferability to wine-relevant matrix behavior.
required_controls: Measure actual natural must G/F/N at t0; model actual initial condition rather than forcing nominal recipe.
risk_if_skipped: Calibration remains synthetic-heavy and may not transfer to natural must.

recommendation: Run in Lot 3, especially if aroma/condensate balances are central.
reason: F5 and F9 are related but not identical; this run targets fast CO2/aroma stripping and terminal condensate information.
required_controls: Maintain online CO2, condensate recovery and aroma liquid samples; verify high-rate temperature profile.
risk_if_skipped: Aroma loss/partition parameters depend mostly on one warm run and terminal condensate evidence weakens.

recommendation: Use as replacement for F7 if Kd0/death should remain estimable rather than fixed.
reason: Kd0 remains the weakest nominal direction even after the full campaign, and Lot 1 dead-biomass signal is small.
required_controls: Needs robust viable/dead biomass measurements and ethanol/death stress trajectory.
risk_if_skipped: Kd0 likely remains a parameter to fix or strongly regularize.

recommendation: Use as replacement for F7 if natural-matrix transfer is more important than Kd0.
reason: The campaign otherwise has only one natural-must designed experiment.
required_controls: Measure actual natural composition and aroma/condensate endpoints.
risk_if_skipped: Natural matrix effects remain assessed from one designed natural run plus historical data only.
